title: The readiness reader applies REPLACE() updates, ignores code text in whole-unit samples and accepts the T3 default logo for an empty logoimage
steps: S1: Read a dump whose appended statement is UPDATE t SET col = REPLACE(col, 'a', 'b') WHERE id = N with the readiness SQL dump reader.
S2: Compare a text slot sample that leaves out the text of a code element with a row whose paragraph holds that code element.
S3: Compare the default-logo sample of a T3 template style whose logoimage param is empty, once with logotype image and once without.
expect: S1: only the targeted row changes, every match is replaced, NULL stays NULL, a non-literal argument is not applied.
S2: the sample is found in the row.
S3: matches only when logotype is image.
fence: The reader reads the release the way the Claude Cowork plugin reads and writes it, so a good release is not flagged red in /ops
